summary: 1930s L-4 tower on Boyd Mountain in Mineral County, Lolo National Forest; one listing says abandoned, another says removed. A state list marks it gone. No source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Brief record matches sources: coordinates 47.33482, -115.22456, Tower type and L-4 design. Agency Lolo National Forest added from both pages (brief had none).
